hints.title: Recursive Partitioning
hints.text: Since string length is small (at most 16), try all valid cut positions recursively.

hints.title: Track Seen Substrings
hints.text: Maintain a set of used substrings to ensure every chosen piece is strictly unique.

hints.title: Backtrack State Restoration
hints.text: Add candidate substring to set, recurse on remainder, then remove substring to explore other splits.

hints.title: Full Implementation

variables: n is length of s (up to 16)
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Greedy choices fail because choosing short substrings early might prevent unique partitions later.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Backtracking with a set takes O(n) call stack and set storage, feasible for n <= 16.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize exponential constraints (n <= 16) and implement clean backtracking with state rollback.
